No yeast? BAKING SODA?! THESE ARE NOT PRETZELS!

Pretzels use yeast, and pretzels use lye (sodium hydroxide). Why lye? Because it is a very strong base, which helps promote the Maillard reaction in the skin of the pretzel. Baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) is just not strong enough. Baking your baking soda in the oven to reduce it to sodium carbonate can help, but even then it won't be as good as actual lye.

Now, where this recipe fucks up AGAIN, is what she does with the baking soda. Even if you're such a pussy that you're scared to use proper lye, the baking soda doesn't go in the dough, it goes in the hot/boiling water that you dip the pretzel in before baking in order to create the aforementioned maillarded crust. Now, she'll need some in the dough as well since no yeast are involved here, but the hot alkaline dip is essential to a pretzel, and a mere fucking egg wash doesn't fucking cut it.

You can get food grade lye off of amazon for quite cheap, and a little goes a long way. (Observe proper safety procedures including gloves, eye protection, strong ventilation, and SLOWLY adding the lye to cold water because it will heat the water as you add it and having your caustic solution boil over onto you leads to nasty heat/chemical burns)
